title: New "Other" day type for one-off schedules
summary: The Calendar Day view's day type picker now has an "Other" option alongside No School/A-Day/B-Day, for days that don't follow the regular A/B bell schedule at all -- field trips, assemblies-only days, half days with a totally custom lineup, etc.

Other days get their own period builder: toggle on whichever periods actually run that day and set their own start/end times, or add fully custom one-off periods (like "Bus Departure") that don't exist anywhere else in your schedule.
A new "Save as reusable schedule" button turns an Other day's periods into a brand-new Schedule Tag, so the same lineup can be reused as a Schedule Tag on any future A-Day or B-Day.
Other days show up with their own distinct badge color everywhere day types are displayed.
